ops.title: Fix order-dependent test pollution: isolate_modules teardown splits state singleton identity
ops.description: Repro: uv run pytest tests/test_pack_graphite.py tests/test_packs.py tests/test_builtin_inline.py tests/test_util_vcs.py -q -> 5 FAILED (general/models, general/tasks, general/tombstones, steering/steering, steering/workarounds; 'Expected Block/Warn, got None'). Each passes alone and in default collection order (full suite green); fails when test_builtin_inline.py runs AFTER any discover_pack+isolate_modules test (incl. pre-existing test_pack_deletions.py — reproduces on clean HEAD, predates the graphite pack). Mechanism per adversarial-review diagnosis: tests/conftest.py isolate_modules teardown re-imports captain_hook.state, so module-level singletons (state.py RESOURCES, SessionStore.TRACKED) split class identity and the NLP-signal nudge/llm_gate hooks stop firing; spaCy reload itself ruled out. Candidate fixes: teardown that restores rather than re-imports captain_hook.state, or make the inline-test runner resolve singletons by module lookup instead of captured reference.

ops.text: uv run pytest tests/test_pack_graphite.py tests/test_packs.py tests/test_builtin_inline.py tests/test_util_vcs.py -q passes in any file order
